title: HD player body: Tauren female (model, textures, faces, hair, skin colors)
description: Replaces the Tauren female player model (display 60) with a community HD body via private CreatureModelData row 2377, plus CharSections rows for every skin/face/hair/facial-hair/underwear variation. Built by tools/characters/build_characters.py into mod-source/characters-hd (shared patch-0 payload with the other 15 bodies).
unavailable_reason: Not reproducible from an owned WoW install: model and textures come from the community VanillaHD/Patch-A repository (commit dcf3647e80104d03c02e1540c61cce3ca7e24766), source M2 Character/Tauren/Female/TaurenFemale.m2 sha256 33bdd242b4865dcf09612405d7505edbd9de53654d7ab2c7ac62c074c16464be. A Retail-derived replacement needs the asset-coverage worker's character-model conversion (retail M2 -> 1.12 format, 5 geoset families, CharSections remap) which is not built yet.
